note: Format layer: chosen from the Director aspect ratio (portrait or square -> vertical_short, landscape -> horizontal) unless director_format_profile names one. Shot mix in percent over the five main sizes; the genre layer biases it and analysed style references replace it. Dialogue coverage (listener share under a line, silent reaction after a line) is drama-general and comes from the DramaBoard aggregates for every format, unless the genre turns coverage off.

vertical_short.label: 9:16 vertical short
vertical_short.rule: FORMAT (9:16 vertical): frame for a phone: one or two large, centred faces, depth stacked foreground to background; wides are rare, only to establish a place or an isolation, then cut in.

horizontal.label: 16:9 horizontal
horizontal.rule: FORMAT (16:9 horizontal): use the width: two-shots and over-the-shoulder pairs hold both faces; wides establish and re-establish geography; characters on thirds, looking into the frame.
